test_title: PYST 2: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Change the following from active to passive:

People found her explanation lacking in coherence.

options.text: Her explanation lacked coherence when people found it.
It was found by people that her explanation lacked coherence.
Her explanation was found to be lacking in coherence.
Her coherence was lacking when it was explained.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "People found her explanation lacking in coherence."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "Her explanation" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "found" (simple past tense) to "was found" (simple past passive).
 
• When the subject of the active sentence is a vague or general noun like "People," it is standard to omit the "by" phrase in the passive construction.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Her explanation was found to be lacking in coherence."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Her explanation lacked coherence when people found it." – Incorrect structure; changes the original meaning and clause relationships entirely.
 
• **Option 2: **"It was found by people that her explanation lacked coherence." – While technically passive, it is structurally awkward, introduces an unnecessary dummy subject ("It"), and keeps the redundant agent ("by people").
 
• **Option 4: **"Her coherence was lacking when it was explained." – Incorrect meaning; completely alters the subject and the original intent of the sentence.
